statement: At the pinned SDL revision, SDL_hidapi_ps5.c opens a HIDAPI joystick and handles native controller reports and effects. Its 'audio haptics' control bit refers to the controller's HID effect handling. This inspected driver has no SDL_Audio device enumeration, ALSA card lookup, PipeWire node lookup or HID-to-sound-card binding. This is a scoped absence in the inspected file, not a proof that every SDL backend or external Steam Input layer lacks association.

applicability.scope: SDL PS5 HIDAPI driver only (joystick open ~921, effects ~683-745); no SDL_Audio references in this complete pinned file. No global SDL negative claim.
